id.description: Unique identifier for this assessment run.

platform.description: Information on the platform the run from the tool that generated the findings was from.

targets.description: The target systems that were assessed. Supports multiple targets of different types.

profiles.description: Information on the baselines that were evaluated, including findings.

statistics.description: Statistics for the assessment run, including duration and result counts.

version.description: Version number of the tool that generated the findings. Example: '5.22.3' is a version of Chef InSpec.

generator.description: Information about the tool that generated this file.

integrity.description: Cryptographic integrity information for verifying this file.

description: The top level value containing all assessment results.
title: HDF Results

title.description: The title - should be human readable.

copyright_email.description: The email address or other contact information of the copyright holder(s).

depends.description: The set of dependencies this baseline depends on.

parent_profile.description: The name of the parent baseline if this is a dependency of another.

summary.description: The summary. Example: the Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) header.

supports.description: The set of supported platform targets.

description.description: The description - should be more detailed than the summary.

inspec_version.description: The version of InSpec used to execute this baseline.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 checksum of the baseline.

sha512.description: The SHA-512 checksum of the baseline (optional).

status_message.description: The reason for the status. Example: why it was skipped or failed to load.

skip_message.description: The reason for skipping if it was skipped.

controls.description: The set of requirements including any findings.

groups.description: A set of descriptions for the requirement groups.

items.description: An input or attribute used in the run.

attributes.description: The input(s) or attribute(s) used in the run.

Evaluated_Baseline.description: Information on a baseline that was evaluated, including any findings.
Evaluated_Baseline.title: Evaluated Baseline

desc.description: The description for the overarching requirement.

descriptions.description: A set of additional descriptions. Example: the 'fix' text.

refs.description: The set of references to external documents.

tags.description: A set of tags - usually metadata like CCI, STIG ID, severity.

code.description: The raw source code of the requirement. Note that if this is an overlay, it does not include the underlying source code.

source_location.description: The explicit location of the requirement within the source code.

results.description: The set of all tests within the requirement and their results.

overall_status.description: The final status of this requirement after all post-processing (attestations, waivers) is applied.

waiver_data.description: Waiver information if this requirement has been waived.

attestation_data.description: Attestation information if this requirement has been manually attested.

Evaluated_Requirement.description: A requirement that has been evaluated, including any findings.
Evaluated_Requirement.title: Evaluated Requirement
